# Otian AI

> Archie is a desktop app that runs your own AI agent on your own computer. You tell the agent a job in plain words, and it does that job on the schedule you set. It works on your computer and answers on your phone. Otian AI is the two-person company that makes it.

This file is a curated map for answer engines. The full machine index is
https://otianai.com/sitemap.xml.

Every claim below is one this site can back with a pointer to the code that makes it
true. https://otianai.com/trust/ is that page, claim by claim, and it lists the ones we got
wrong along with the ones we got right. If a claim here cannot be checked there, it is
a mistake and we want to hear about it: questions@otianai.com.

## Common questions

- **What is Archie?** A desktop app that runs an AI agent on your own computer. It handles mail, calendar, and recurring jobs, and you reach it from Telegram, Discord, Slack, Matrix, or iMessage on a Mac. It is not a chatbot you open and type into: it runs on a schedule and comes back when it has something.
- **Does Otian AI see my conversations?** No. When your agent thinks, it talks to Anthropic or OpenAI directly from your computer, on your account, with your key. We are not in the middle of it, and we keep no copy. What we do hold is your email address, your plan, and the operational records listed at https://otianai.com/trust/#what-we-hold. Your prompts still go to your AI provider, who is a third party; the claim is about Otian custody, not about secrecy from everyone.
- **Where does it run?** On a computer you own and leave on. There is no Otian server running your agent, which is why there is no Otian copy of what it reads. A hosted agent platform cannot make that claim, because the runtime that assembles the prompt is theirs.
- **What does it cost?** $30 a month, or $299 a year. Archie for Business is $99 a month or $999 a year. The AI itself is billed by your AI provider, to you, at their price: we add nothing to it. There is a plan with the AI included at $59 a month or $599 a year, which carries $25 of usage a month; email and text reading need your own AI key. Plans are on sale now, while Archie is in testing. Guided setup is $250 for an hour. App refunds within 14 days of first starting a plan.
- **Do I need to know how to code?** No. Add-ons are written in plain words, not code, and you install one by picking it. Setting up an agent is answering a few questions about what it is for.
- **What is an add-on?** One job you hand the agent. The public catalog has 160 add-ons, included with Archie: Skills, Routines, and Personalities.
- **Can it send email or change my calendar on its own?** Mail goes out when you tap Send or set a time for it, and a calendar change is proposed and waits for your confirmation. It buys only if you switch that on, at shops you pick, up to a limit you set. It reads your calendar and answers chat messages without asking each time, which is the same door being useful, and is worth knowing before you connect either.
- **What can it connect to?** 49 apps and services: 5 chat apps, 7 AI companies, and 37 accounts and devices. Connections use your accounts, local files or devices, and only what you choose to connect.
- **Which AI models can it use?** Your pick of 7 companies: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Groq, xAI, DeepSeek, and Mistral. You can also point it at any OpenAI-format endpoint you name. You bring the account and the key, and the provider bills you directly at their price.
- **How many agents and people?** The plan runs 10 agents; the free trial runs 1. In the personal edition one agent answers one person, enforced in code. Archie for Business runs 50 agents and puts no ceiling on how many people an agent answers.
- **Is there a free plan?** Archie is free on an AI account of your own, in the personal edition: 20 jobs a day, and the count starts again at midnight. A job is one piece of work: a reply to you, a routine running, or an email it reacts to. A plan takes the limit off for $30 a month. Separately, a new install can try Archie for up to 14 days on our starter credits, with no AI account and no card. Archie for Business has no free tier.
- **What can I check for myself?** All of it, and that is the point. https://otianai.com/trust/ lists every claim on this site with a pointer to the code that makes it true, and carries a 10-minute walkthrough for verifying the custody claim yourself with a network monitor. Claims we have not shipped are labelled as roadmap, and claims that were true and stopped being true are listed as corrections.

## The product

- [Archie for Personal](https://otianai.com/archie/personal/): AI agents on your own computer for your email, calendar and bills. Free on your own AI account at 20 jobs a day, or up to 10 agents for $30 a month.
- [Archie for Business](https://otianai.com/archie/business/): Archie for Business runs up to 50 agents on your own computer and AI account, and anyone you let in can message them. They sort the shared inbox, chase unpaid invoices and draft replies.
- [How It Works](https://otianai.com/how-it-works/): Install Archie on a computer you can leave on, set up an agent from add-ons, and message it from Telegram, Discord, Slack, Matrix or iMessage. What you need, what you can skip, and the five setup steps.
- [Archie Pricing](https://otianai.com/archie/pricing/): Archie is free on your own AI account at 20 jobs a day, or $30 a month for up to 10 agents with every add-on. Archie for Business is $99 a month. The AI bills you directly: $1 to $5 a month for a light agent, up to $139 for a heavy one.
- [Archie Mobile](https://otianai.com/archie/mobile/): Archie Mobile reaches the agent on your computer from your phone, sealed on the way under a key we never receive. You can install it on Android today; on iPhone it is with Apple for review. What it can do, and what stays on your computer.

## Services we offer

- [Working With Us](https://otianai.com/services/): We set up Archie with you over Zoom, build a larger setup in phases, or build an add-on to order. Each starts with a free call: $250 an hour for the first two, and a quote per add-on for the third.

## Add-ons

- [Add-on Marketplace](https://otianai.com/skills-marketplace/browse/): Browse the personalities, skills and routines your agent can take on, all included with Archie. Join the waitlist to hear when the marketplace opens.
- [Find an Add-on](https://otianai.com/skills-marketplace/find/): Describe a job you want off your plate in plain words and see which Otian AI add-ons already do it. No account, no AI, and nothing you type leaves your browser.
- [For Developers](https://otianai.com/skills-marketplace/for-developers/): Build an add-on for Archie and submit it for review. An accepted add-on is listed under your name and included with Archie for everyone, and listing is free.

## Privacy, security and claims

- [Trust](https://otianai.com/trust/): See what Archie sends from your computer, who receives it, and how to check its connections yourself with a network monitor.
- [Run the checks yourself](https://otianai.com/trust/proof/): Four of our privacy claims, running live in your browser: the activity record's SHA-256 fingerprints, the sealed phone mailbox, this page's own requests, and the pairing key a browser keeps out of the request.
- [Trust: The Long Version](https://otianai.com/trust/details/): The full reasoning behind the Trust page: the limits of the approval gate, what happens to Archie if you stop or we do, and the 10-minute check you can run yourself.
- [For an IT review: Archie](https://otianai.com/trust/it-review/): The page to send to whoever approves software where you work: what Archie installs, what it connects to, what it never does, and a review document you can attach to a ticket.
- [Reporting a security problem](https://otianai.com/security/): Where to send a security problem you found in Archie, what we do with it, and how fast.
- [Privacy Policy](https://otianai.com/privacy-policy/): How Otian AI collects, uses, and protects your information.
- [Terms of Service](https://otianai.com/terms-of-service/): The terms that govern your use of Otian AI's website and services.

Then five comparisons: Cowork, Grok Bot, Symphony and Muse; the chat app you pay for;...
- [Archie vs ChatGPT and Claude](https://otianai.com/compare/chat-apps/): A chat app answers in its own window, on its company’s servers. Archie runs an agent on your own computer that thinks with the same AI companies’ models, on your own accounts, on a schedule you set. A side-by-side, including what a chat...
- [Archie vs Claude Cowork, Grok Bot, Symphony and Meta Muse](https://otianai.com/compare/cloud-agents/): Claude Cowork, Grok Bot and Meta Muse work on a computer their company runs, and Wix does not say where Symphony’s agents do. Archie runs an agent you own, on your own computer. Both sides of that trade, priced, sourced and dated.
- [Archie vs Zapier, Make and n8n](https://otianai.com/compare/automation-tools/): Automation tools do exactly what their diagram says. An agent is told the job in a sentence and works out the steps. Prices, tradeoffs, and four reasons to keep your automations.
- [Archie vs OpenClaw, Hermes, Vellum and Building It Yourself](https://otianai.com/compare/building-it-yourself/): OpenClaw, Hermes and Vellum publish their code and can run on your own computer, as Archie runs on yours. What Archie sells is the connections, the approval before an email or calendar change, and the updates, already built, with an...
- [Archie vs Hiring an Assistant](https://otianai.com/compare/hiring-an-assistant/): A person handles judgment and an agent handles repetition. A comparison of Archie and a part-time assistant, including four things Archie does not do.

## What we do not claim

- Archie buys only if its owner switches that on, only at shops they pick, and only up to a limit they set.
- It connects to no bank. The add-ons that track bills and spending keep the list you
  give them.
- We are not a compliance certification. Your content still flows to a cloud AI
  provider under your own account, so nothing here makes a deployment HIPAA or GDPR
  compliant on its own.
- We hold your email address and your plan. Any page saying we collect nothing is
  wrong, and we have listed what we hold rather than rounding it to zero.
- Windows builds are not code-signed yet, so Windows shows a warning on first run.
  The install page says what we are doing about it and how to check the download
  without having to trust us.
